info.title: active-reports
info.description: Internal preview CLI for local ActiveReports .NET RDLX workflows.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Deterministic local RDLX workflows for ActiveReports .NET. Read --help for syntax, read reference for patch contracts, and run system doctor before the first real task.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: json, table, yaml, markdown. [default: json]

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Verbosity: quiet, normal, verbose, diagnostic. [default: normal]

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI color output. [default: False]

commands.name: report
commands.description: Create new reports, apply deterministic write operations, canonicalize saves, and diff report files.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new blank report or clone a template into a target .rdlx path.

options.name: --name
options.description: Human-friendly report name. Defaults to the output file name.

options.name: --report-type
options.description: Report type label, for example PageReport.

options.name: --template-path
options.description: Optional path to an existing .rdlx template to clone first.

options.name: --page-width
options.description: Page width measurement such as 8.5in.

options.name: --page-height
options.description: Page height measurement such as 11in.

options.name: --margin
options.description: Page margin measurement such as 0.5in.

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Execute a single JSON batch file that can create a report and apply data, layout, style, format, and validation steps.

options.name: --batch-file
options.description: JSON batch file that creates or updates a report with data, layout, style, format, and validation sections.

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: patch
commands.description: Apply one deterministic write operation family at a time. Read reference patch <kind> before building the JSON payload.

commands.name: layout
commands.description: Apply layout patch operations from JSON. Use after inspect when adding or moving items.

options.name: --patch-file
options.description: JSON file describing the layout patch payload. Read 'active-reports reference patch layout' for the schema and minimum example.

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Optional output .rdlx path. If omitted, the source report path is overwritten.

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: data
commands.description: Apply data source, dataset, and parameter patches from JSON.

options.name: --patch-file
options.description: JSON file describing the data patch payload. Read 'active-reports reference patch data' for the schema and minimum example.

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Optional output .rdlx path. If omitted, the source report path is overwritten.

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: style
commands.description: Apply selector-based style patches from JSON. Use for fonts, colors, borders, alignment, and padding.

options.name: --patch-file
options.description: JSON file describing the style patch payload. Read 'active-reports reference patch style' for the schema and minimum example.

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Optional output .rdlx path. If omitted, the source report path is overwritten.

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: format
commands.description: Apply field format rules from JSON. Use for locale, null display, and format strings.

options.name: --patch-file
options.description: JSON file describing the format patch payload. Read 'active-reports reference patch format' for the schema and minimum example.

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Optional output .rdlx path. If omitted, the source report path is overwritten.

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: save
commands.description: Canonicalize and save a report after validate passes. Optionally re-run runtime checks before writing.

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Optional output .rdlx path. If omitted, the source report path is overwritten.

options.name: --save-comment
options.description: Optional canonical-save comment.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Enable runtime verification when the command supports it. [default: True]

options.name: --no-runtime
options.description: Disable runtime verification for this invocation. [default: False]

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare two report files to review changes, regressions, or generated output drift.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Read-only inspection commands. Use these before risky edits so patch payloads target the real structure.

commands.name: structure
commands.description: Return the normalized top-level report structure. Start here on unfamiliar reports.

commands.name: layout-model
commands.description: Return the normalized layout model with controls, geometry, and styles.

commands.name: layout-score
commands.description: Score layout quality and suggest layout operations. Use before refine when the report looks off.

options.name: --rule-pack-version
options.description: Optional rule-pack version marker used in diagnostics and scoring.

commands.name: handoff-summary
commands.description: Generate a manual review checklist and risk summary for human follow-up.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Inspect datasource schema metadata with an explicit confirmation gate.

options.name: --data-source
options.description: Optional data source name when the report contains more than one candidate.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Required consent gate for schema inspection against datasource metadata. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-table
options.description: Optional allowed table names or schema.table names.

options.name: --max-tables
options.description: Maximum tables or views to return from schema inspection. [default: 50]

options.name: --max-columns-per-table
options.description: Maximum columns to return per table during schema inspection. [default: 100]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Parse, lint, and optional runtime-backed validation. Run after every write.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run parse, lint, or full validation after writes. Use --no-runtime for fast structural checks.

options.name: --level
options.description: Validation level: full, lint, parse-only. [default: full]

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Enable runtime verification when the command supports it. [default: True]

options.name: --no-runtime
options.description: Disable runtime verification for this invocation. [default: False]

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Run lint-focused validation when the report already parses.

options.name: --rule-pack-version
options.description: Optional rule-pack version marker used in diagnostics and scoring.

commands.name: refine
commands.description: Bounded automatic improvement commands for cases where inspect and score show layout issues.

commands.name: layout
commands.description: Run deterministic layout refinement toward a target score. Use after inspect/layout-score, not as a blind first step.

options.name: --max-iterations
options.description: Maximum refinement iterations before stopping. [default: 3]

options.name: --target-score
options.description: Target layout score for refine layout. [default: 80]

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Optional output .rdlx path. If omitted, the source report path is overwritten.

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: chart-readability
commands.description: Apply conservative chart readability refinements and return suggestions for changes that require author judgment.

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Optional output .rdlx path. If omitted, the source report path is overwritten.

options.name: --created-by
options.description: Actor identifier for audit trails. Defaults to active-reports-cli.

commands.name: runtime
commands.description: ActiveReports runtime verification commands for cases where static validation is not enough.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Ask the ActiveReports runtime to load, validate, or smoke-run the report.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Runtime mode: load-only, validate, run-smoke, export-smoke, full. [default: load-only]

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render preview or deliverable artifacts from an .rdlx report.

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Render a stable PDF preview or deliverable. Use for handoff packages and review output.

options.name: --output-path

options.name: --pdf-title

options.name: --pdf-author

options.name: --pdf-embed-fonts

commands.name: image
commands.description: Render per-page images for quick visual inspection and chat-friendly previews.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for per-page rendered files. Use either --output-dir or --output-path.

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Prototype-compatible target image path. For multi-page renders, files are written beside this path using its base name.

options.name: --base-name
options.description: Optional base file name for rendered files. Defaults to the report file name.

options.name: --format
options.description: Image format: png, jpeg, bmp, gif, tiff. [default: png]

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Target render DPI for image previews. [default: 144]

options.name: --start-page
options.description: First image page to render. Use 0 to render all pages.

options.name: --end-page
options.description: Last image page to render.

options.name: --dpi-x
options.description: Image output horizontal DPI.

options.name: --dpi-y
options.description: Image output vertical DPI.

options.name: --pagination
options.description: Whether image rendering should create separate pages: true or false.

options.name: --page-width
options.description: Override image render page width, such as 8.5in.

options.name: --page-height
options.description: Override image render page height, such as 11in.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare rendered artifacts for benchmark review.

options.name: --expected
options.description: Expected/reference render artifact path.

options.name: --max-difference-percent
options.description: Allowed difference percentage before the comparison fails. [default: 0]

commands.name: semantic-review
commands.description: Review generated RDLX semantics against a benchmark spec without requiring pixel parity.

options.name: --benchmark
options.description: Benchmark spec JSON file.

commands.name: capability
commands.description: Gallery-derived capability inventory and matrix commands for benchmarking readiness.

commands.name: inventory
commands.description: Inspect raw report examples and summarize observed report items, data providers, and feature flags.

options.name: --raw
options.description: Directory containing raw .rdlx/.rdsx reports.

options.name: --write
options.description: Optional path to write the full inventory JSON.

commands.name: matrix
commands.description: Build an operation coverage matrix from a capability inventory JSON file.

options.name: --inventory
options.description: Capability inventory JSON file.

options.name: --write
options.description: Optional path to write the full matrix JSON.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Evaluate a capability matrix and fail when observed capabilities map to planned or missing operations.

options.name: --matrix
options.description: Capability matrix JSON file.

options.name: --require
options.description: Comma-separated maturity dimensions: create, mutate, inspect, lint, runtime, referenceParity. Defaults to all dimensions.

commands.name: benchmark
commands.description: Validate benchmark specs against a capability matrix.

options.name: --benchmarks
options.description: Directory containing *.benchmark.json specs.

options.name: --matrix
options.description: Capability matrix JSON file.

options.name: --raw
options.description: Optional raw .rdlx directory. When provided, every raw report must have a benchmark spec.

commands.name: run-benchmark
commands.description: Run an agent-authored batch against one benchmark spec and semantic acceptance checks.

options.name: --benchmark
options.description: Benchmark spec JSON file.

options.name: --batch-file
options.description: JSON batch file that creates or updates a report with data, layout, style, format, and validation sections.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for per-page rendered files.

options.name: --reference-render
options.description: Optional reference render artifact to compare against after generating the benchmark report.

options.name: --max-difference-percent
options.description: Optional visual difference tolerance percentage. Defaults to the benchmark acceptance value.

commands.name: reference-renders
commands.description: Render raw benchmark source reports and write a reference-render manifest.

options.name: --benchmarks
options.description: Directory containing *.benchmark.json specs.

options.name: --raw
options.description: Directory containing raw source .rdlx reports.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for per-page rendered files.

options.name: --format
options.description: Reference render format: pdf, png, jpeg, bmp, gif, or tiff. [default: pdf]

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Optional manifest JSON path. Defaults to reference-renders.manifest.json in the output directory.

commands.name: reference
commands.description: Built-in contracts, examples, output envelope, and exit code reference. Read here before authoring patch JSON by hand.

commands.name: design-playbook
commands.description: Show obligation-first report design guidance for agents before authoring non-trivial reports.

commands.name: patch
commands.description: Read patch payload contracts and minimum examples before calling report patch.

commands.name: layout
commands.description: Show the layout patch schema, supported ops, and minimum example.

commands.name: data
commands.description: Show the data patch schema, supported ops, and minimum example.

commands.name: style
commands.description: Show the style patch schema, selectors, and minimum example.

commands.name: format
commands.description: Show the format patch schema and minimum example.

commands.name: report-model-schema
commands.description: Reflect the public Page/RDLX report model controls, properties, nested types, and enums.

commands.name: modern-chart-schema
commands.description: Show designer-backed modern chart plot types, encodings, properties, and per-family support matrix.

options.name: --source
options.description: Optional path to an ActiveReports designer package, extracted package directory, or web-designer.js file.

commands.name: output-contract
commands.description: Show the standard command JSON envelope and the fields an agent should read.

commands.name: exit-codes
commands.description: Show process exit codes and what each code means.

commands.name: system
commands.description: Environment diagnostics and deterministic smoke tests. Run doctor first; run self-test after install, path, or build changes.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Inspect .NET, ActiveReports runtime loadability, Jet helper availability, and optional target path access.

options.name: --report-path
options.description: Optional report path to probe for read access, write access, and runtime loadability.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Enable runtime verification when the command supports it. [default: False]

options.name: --no-runtime
options.description: Disable runtime verification for this invocation. [default: False]

commands.name: self-test
commands.description: Run the fixed smoke flow (create, patch, inspect, validate, save) and write a JSON result file with step events.

options.name: --runtime
options.description: Enable runtime verification when the command supports it. [default: False]

options.name: --no-runtime
options.description: Disable runtime verification for this invocation. [default: False]

options.name: --output-file
options.description: Optional output JSON file for self-test. Defaults to self-test-last.json inside the default self-test working directory.

options.name: --working-dir
options.description: Optional working directory for generated self-test artifacts. Defaults to a user-writable active-reports-cli self-test directory.

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Install and manage the bundled local Agent Skill. Report content is never processed by this command group.

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Manage the portable active-reports-authoring skill for Codex, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the bundled skill package and supported client adapters without writing files.

commands.name: status

options.name: --client

options.name: --scope

options.name: --project-dir

options.name: --client
options.description: Client adapter: codex, claude, copilot, or all. [default: all]

options.name: --scope

options.name: --project-dir
options.description: Project root for project scope. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --force

options.name: --scope
